newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Swissair aircraft diverted to Vienna by bomb threat.
newsitem.headline: Swissair aircraft diverted to Vienna by bomb threat.

text.p: A Swissair aircraft with 46 passengers on board, en route to Zurich from Krakow, Poland, was diverted to Vienna after a bomb threat was received, a Swissair spokesman said on Sunday.
The bomb threat was telephoned to Krakow airport after the aircraft left Poland on schedule at 1210 GMT. It was due to arrive in Zurich airport at 1410 GMT.
The spokesman could not give any details, but said such threats were not unusual.
The aircraft, a Saab 2000 flown by Swissair's regional airline unit Crossair AG, was diverted to Vienna airport, where it landed at 1330 GMT.
Airport officials have been searching the aircraft's cabin and the Swissair spokesman said the plane is likely to take off for Zurich later this afternoon.
The cargo has been removed from the plane and will take longer to search, he added.
